WITH step1 AS (
    SELECT 
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(HGB) as avg_HGB,
        AVG(CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NULL OR CRE IS NULL OR CRE = 0 THEN NULL ELSE `T-BIL` / CRE END) as avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
step2 AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
    FROM step1
)
SELECT 
    step1.CENTROMEA as col1,
    step1.avg_HGB as col2,
    step1.avg_ratio as col3,
    CASE WHEN step2.overall_avg_ratio = 0 THEN NULL ELSE step1.avg_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio END as col4
FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
